title: The Hard Deadline
author: Yara Delacroix
blurb: Mara Marchetti, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
